claimed_coverage: Tests that WGSL shader source files contain correct variable references (fragmentInputs.*, uniforms.*) and proper WGSL syntax (var vs uvar, vec4f construction, fragmentOutputs return) for WebGPU shader compilation.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix.patch corrects 5 WGSL shader files: bumpFragment.fx uses fragmentInputs.vDetailUV/vBumpUV instead of bare variables and vec3f() for detailNormal scaling; depthPrePass.fx uses fragmentOutputs.color and return fragmentOutputs; oitFragment.fx uses var instead of uvar; morphTargetsVertex.fx uses vec4f() for tangent updates; default.fragment.fx uses fragmentInputs.vDecalUV and uniforms.vDetailInfos.
issue_context_used: The issue describes WebGPU rendering failures due to incorrect shader variable references and syntax errors, which the tests verify by checking the exact patterns fixed in the patch.
notes: Hidden tests verify WGSL shader source files contain the correct patterns from fix.patch. Tests run from /artifacts/evaluation context using workspace's Jest installation. Tests verify 5 shader files across 15 test cases covering all bug fixes.
